skills.detail:
When You Have a Mirror Set:
Moves towards your mirror. A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect.

When You Have No Mirror Set:
A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: There Is No Escape!!

skills.detail:
When Counter Succeeds:
If enemy attacks within a set period of time, increases own DEF. Draws in enemies within a certain area at mid-range towards the Respawn Area and has a chance of inflicting Capture Block.

When Counter Fails:
If the enemy does not attack within a set period of time, draws in enemies within a certain area at close-range towards the Respawn Area and has a chance of inflicting Capture Block.

Become temporarily invincible after use.
